import copy,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
from src.tools import g01_physics_smoke as smoke

command=['python3','-u','-m',smoke.MODULE,'--name',run,'--scene','FloorPlan21','--quota-plan',new['file'],'--quota-plan-sha256',new['sha256'],'--timeout-seconds','1000','--sample-rejected-raw']

with (root/'results'/f'{name}.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(result,f,indent=2,allow_nan=False);f.write('\n')
print('FINAL_METRICS_JSON: '+json.dumps(metrics,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False),flush=True)
